baseline: ttc5; selection anchored to actual current state, frozen within all candidates

H3.oracle: actual next human observations after the same root real step; root/history/previous action restored for shadow scoring

H2.alpha_selection: H1 corrected Pareto winner; otherwise alpha0 primary and alpha0.3 descriptive secondary
H2.extra_candidate_scored_separately: preserves bitwise values/windows of original 80; filter recomputed over all81
H2.adoption: KDA SR gain corrected p<0.05, observed CR and TO no higher than baseline; this does not prove statistical noninferiority

family.case_clustering: same numeric case repeated across cells: additionally report case-cluster bootstrap intervals; pooled McNemar independence remains a limitation

H1_winner: at least one corrected favorable SR/CR/TO change and no corrected unfavorable change; mixed tradeoffs mean no clear winner
controls: Mamba/GRU descriptive only, never included in testing family or adoption
H3_negative_scope: only current frozen value consumer at0.25s; not all prediction/multistep planning
final_choice: at most one; among validated H1/H2 Pareto gains choose larger KDA SR gain, ties favor H1; otherwise H3 sensitivity is only an unvalidated lead
